title: LinkJumkey Add Button v1 options
description: Validates the named options object passed to createLink/createDesktopLink in integration code. This is not an import-file schema or an instruction to generate or copy a JSON file. Implement a user-clicked control that opens the returned URL; the user confirms and saves in LinkJumkey. Desktop 1.8.21+ supports direct add and Notes. URL parsing and encoded aggregate length must also pass SDK validation; schema validation alone does not prove an import will fit. Open linkjumkey://add? through the OS, or navigate to https://linkjumkey.matsumotojoho.com/import.html#add=1& with the fields. No localhost port or executable path is configured for this add-link contract. Do not POST this options object to an invented HTTP endpoint; the separate local library API is a different contract and its createButton does not accept notes URLs.

title.description: Button display name; trimmed before the 120 UTF-16-unit limit. Nonblank; no ASCII controls. Not positional argv.

url.description: Complete absolute http, https or notes URL, without credentials. Obtain NotesURL from the source document API; do not concatenate a document ID alone.

project.description: Destination project name, trimmed; default 外部サイト. Merge into the root of the same-name project, creating it if absent. Keep default merge for addition; choosing replace can remove existing contents of that project. This contract cannot select an arbitrary destination folder. Nonblank with no ASCII controls; case-sensitive reserved names are forbidden even with surrounding spaces.

note.description: Plain text; CRLF/CR normalize to LF, HTML escaped. TAB/LF/CR allowed; other ASCII controls forbidden. At most 2000 UTF-16 units before normalization.

typeMode.description: template appends URL-encoded common input; no placeholders. Notes only supports fixed.

$comment: SDK validation is authoritative. SDK limits use JavaScript UTF-16 string length after title/project trimming; JSON Schema maxLength uses Unicode code points. Both generated URI length and canonical UTF-8 JSON Base64URL payload length must be <=8000. Reject malformed/duplicate/unknown URI parameters.
